versions.content: Memory stack shall provide a queuing mechanism Type: draft Description: In order to accept jobs from multiple users, the memory stack shall provide a queuing mechanism. Rationale: Queue user requests to the memory stack. Dependencies: Use Case: The memory stack and FOTA want to read and write data at the same time. No requests are rejected in case the addressed flash driver is already busy, but will be queued and processed as soon as possible. Supporting Material:
